name: Dandelion
intro: A dandelion is a bright yellow flower. Its seeds float away on the wind.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A dandelion has a bright yellow flower.
The flower is made of many tiny flowers.
Its leaves have jagged edges like teeth.
Its stem is hollow inside.
A broken stem has white, milky juice.

sections.title: Where does it grow?
sentences: Dandelions first grew in Europe and Asia.
Now they grow on every continent but Antarctica.
They grow in lawns, fields, and gardens.
They can even grow in sidewalk cracks.

sections.title: What does it need?
sentences: A dandelion grows well in full sun.
It likes deep soil that drains well.
It can grow in many kinds of soil.
Its seeds need light to sprout.
It needs some water to keep the soil damp.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A dandelion grows a long root called a taproot.
The root stores food through the winter.
The plant comes back every spring.
The yellow flower turns into a white puffball.
Each seed has a tiny parachute that floats on the wind.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: The name dandelion means "lion's tooth" in French.
The flower opens in the day and closes at night.
Bees visit dandelions for food in early spring.
One flower can make hundreds of seeds.
Its root can grow deeper than a grown-up is tall.

vocab.meaning: One long, thick root that grows straight down.
The white puffball full of seeds.
One of the seven very large pieces of land on Earth.
